factor_name: Renegotiation frictions proxied by normalized number of institutional shareholders
paper_ref: Valta, Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis, forthcoming
economic_intuition: More institutional shareholders proxy for higher renegotiation frictions; higher frictions reduce the strategic default option value and increase required stock returns, especially near the renegotiation threshold.
detailed_definition: Logarithm of the number of different institutional shareholders divided by the logarithm of the market value of equity.

required_fields.concept: Altman Z-score used to assign firm-month observations to pooled Z-score quartiles; lowest quartile identifies firms close to the renegotiation threshold.
required_fields.source_detail: The paper calculates Z-score for every firm-month observation and splits observations into quartiles.
The paper uses the number of institutional shareholders as a proxy for renegotiation frictions.

required_fields.concept: Pooled quartile rank based on Altman Z-score; quartile 1 is the lowest Z-score group close to the renegotiation threshold.
required_fields.source_detail: The paper pools observations and splits the sample into quartiles based on the Z-score.
